title: Hubmer Family Farm's Sustainable Practices
reason: The video discusses sustainable farming practices, equipment use, and recycling methods.

tasks.task: Describe the sustainable farming techniques used at the Hubmer farm.

subtasks.text: Explain the ridge tilling method used for planting soybeans.
Highlight the benefits of using ridge tilling, including reduced erosion and better moisture retention.

tasks.task: Describe the use of cover crops and banding fertilizer.

subtasks.text: Show the cover crops (rye and vetch) that were planted in the field.
Explain the process of banding fertilizer for the next year's crop.

tasks.task: Discuss the role of the manure storage system and its contribution to recycling.

subtasks.text: Show the manure storage system where the gutters transport manure.
Explain how the manure from the hogs is recycled back into the fields.

tasks.task: Describe the history and evolution of the Hubmer farm.

subtasks.text: Show a historical photo of the farm from the early 1920s.
